sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Tug of Heads is a wrestling game where two stickmen face off against each other in a series of matches. Each level presents a unique set of challenges and obstacles that will test your skills and reflexes. From moving platforms to spinning blades, the game's designers have thought of everything to make Tug of Heads a truly immersive experience.

The gameplay mechanics are simple, yet deep and complex. Players use the keyboard or mobile controls to move their stickman and avoid obstacles. As the game progresses, new mechanics are introduced, such as the ability to grab and throw opponents, or use special moves to gain an advantage. The game also features power-ups and items that can be used to gain an edge or turn the tide of battle in your favor.

One of the things that sets Tug of Heads apart from other wrestling games is its focus on strategy and skill. Unlike other games where the outcome is determined by chance, Tug of Heads rewards players for their skills and reflexes.
